name: Louvre G 482
caption: Detail of the figural scene on side A, left of center: Phoinix, bearded, leaning 3/4-view to the right on a staff, wearing slippers, a himation, and a taenia
credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

name: Louvre G 482
caption: Detail of the figural scene on side A, center: Achilles, swathed in a himation (covering his head), seated on a klismos, profile to the right; the klismos stands on a dais in front of a thin column
credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

name: Louvre G 482
caption: Detail of the figural scene on side A, right of center: an attenuated Doric column; Thetis, standing frontally, with her head profile to the left, wearing a belted peplos over a short-sleeved chiton, jewelry, and a thick taenia; she holds a spear upright in her left hand, while her right hand rests on a shield which stands slightly behind her
credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

name: Louvre G 482
caption: Detail of the figural scene on side A, right: a Nereid, advancing to the left, shown in 3/4-view, wearing a himation over a medium-sleeved chiton, with a kekryphylon binding her hair; she holds her left hand at waist level, and holds a Corinthian helmet in her upraised right hand
credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

name: Louvre G 482
caption: Detail of the figural scene on side B, left: a woman running to the left, who turns her head profile to the right, while she reaches her right hand to the left; she wears a himation over a short-sleeved chiton, and holds some of her drapery above her left shoulder
credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

name: Louvre G 482
caption: Detail of the figural scene on side B, left of center: a woman running to the left, with both arms upraised, who turns her head profile to the right; she wears a belted, short-sleeved chiton, and a broad stephane
credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

name: Louvre G 482
caption: Detail of the figural scene on side B, center: Menelaos, a youthful warrior running profile to the right, wearing greaves, a cuirass over a chitoniskos, and an Attic helmet, armed with a sword, spear, and hoplite shield
credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

name: Louvre G 482
caption: Detail of the figural scene on side B, right: a female figure, perhaps Aphrodite, advancing in 3/4-view to the right, with her left arm raised, reaches her right hand back to the warrior behind her, to whom she turns her head; she wears a himation over a short-sleeved chiton, and a taenia wrapped in her hair
credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

name: Louvre G 482
caption: Detail of the figural scene under the left handles: a woman, probably Helen,  advancing in 3/4-view to the right, with her left arm raised, turns back to look behind her (to the left), and holds her left hand, as if in hesitation, just above her left shoulder
credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre
